manifest.description: Pull a cluster of self.<field> reads into a separate struct, wire as a delegate, and rewrite source-side accesses conservatively.
when_to_use: 5+ fields on a struct are read/written together as a logical cluster
operator wants to break a circular dependency by extracting a sub-state
operator wants to make a field cluster independently testable
anti_patterns: do not use to strategize complex initialization order - the atom wires constructors mechanically, not by reasoning about timing
do not use on #[repr(C)] or #[repr(packed)] structs unless the operator supplied the dispatch-side ToolArgDefaults grant
do not use when a different atom (rust-impl-partition-graph) would help operator decide which fields cluster
